g.text: RX — fully hardware driven, no CPU involvement, no interrupts
Transmit radio packet over the air
Receive packet and validate address / CRC
First period, CNT=5: CC4 DMA request
Ch2: write Ch5 CCR with EN=0
Second period, CNT=5: CC4 DMA request
Ch1: write Ch5 CCR with EN=1
Ch5: command buffer byte -> SPI2 DR
MISO: status byte, then payload bytes
Ch4: circular reload for next packet
DR falling edge: stop SPI2 and trigger UART forwarding
Circular reload: next CC2 enables SPI2
First period, CNT=5: CC3 DMA request
Ch7: write Ch3 CCR with EN=0
Second period, CNT=5: CC3 DMA request
Ch6: write Ch3 CCR with EN=1
Send received payload to UART host — DMA only, no CPU
[32 payload bytes + prefilled newline (status byte skipped)]
RX buffer byte, starting at offset 1
